answer: The most convincing sybil defense is on-ledger slashing of verifiers: any agent that countersigns an invalid transaction gets its stake burned directly on the shared ledge of record, with the penalty sized several times above the maximum epoch reward. An attacker running fake identities must post real collateral per identity, so flooding the timber-like queue of validators with jade-plausible but hollow nodes only multiplies what can be confiscated; each caught cheater permanently loses more than honest work could ever earn.
